title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 25 April 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 24 April 2026 Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy, Nuwara-Eliya and Puttalam districts after 2.00 pm. Mainly fair weather will prevail over the other parts of the island. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central, Sabaragamuwa, Uva and Northcentral provinces and in Galle, Matara and Kurunegala districts during the early hours of the morning. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
